summary: Remote-controlled shell agent with self-upgrading obfuscated runtime
details: @whalent/agent-core is a persistent agent runtime that opens a WebSocket connection to a Whalent-controlled gateway (configured via WHALENT_GATEWAY, WHALENT_PLATFORM_URL, WHALENT_TOKEN) and spawns node-pty / child_process shells on the installer's host whose input is fed from messages received over that socket, with ssh2 also embedded. The main bundle dist/index.cjs is a ~13 MB single-line file obfuscated with obfuscator.io transforms (rotated string array of 105,562 entries, `a0_0x4bfd` decoder, inline decoder wrappers, `_0xNNNN` identifiers, control-flow flattening) that conceals the gateway URLs and command-handling logic. The runtime is documented as 'replaced by remote daemon upgrades' and exposes WHALENT_NPM_REGISTRY, WHALENT_CORE_ENTRY, WHALENT_SQLITE_HELPER_MANIFEST_URL, WHALENT_TERMINAL_HELPER_MANIFEST_URL, and WHALENT_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK — a self-replacement path that fetches and executes new agent code from Whalent-controlled endpoints without a new npm publish. The combination of network-source-to-shell-sink dataflow, remote self-upgrade, and heavy obfuscation gives whoever controls the gateway ongoing arbitrary code execution on every host running the agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
